title: Tuning Crystal Packing and Magnetic Properties in a Series of [Dy12] Metallocubanes Based on Azobenzene Derivatives of Salicylic Acid

synthesis.procedure: L1 (0.20 mmol) and dysprosium nitrate pentahydrate (0.40 mmol) were dissolved in 18 mL of DMF:EtOH (1:1), stirred 30 min at room temperature, then triethylamine (1.00 mmol) was added. The mixture was stirred 24 h at room temperature and filtered. Vapor diffusion of acetonitrile into the filtrate for 1 week afforded crystals.
synthesis.time: stirred 30 min then 24 h; vapor diffusion 1 week
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution stirring followed by vapor diffusion with acetonitrile
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; crystals grown from filtrate by acetonitrile vapor diffusion over 1 week

properties.summary: Zero-field SMM-like slow magnetic relaxation with a single process fitted to Orbach plus Raman contributions. Room-temperature χMT matches 12 Dy(III) ions; weak antiferromagnetic exchange at low T. After 365 nm UV irradiation, Ueff decreases, indicating weakening of the SMM effect attributed to partial trans–cis ligand isomerization.

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: low temperature down to ~1.8 K (series range)

measurements.name: Ueff
measurements.conditions: zero dc field; Orbach+Raman fit; τ0 = 2.37(5)×10−4 s; BRaman = 0.15(5) s−1 K−n; n = 4.88(17)

measurements.name: Ueff (after UV irradiation)
measurements.conditions: powder irradiated ~12 h at 365 nm; τ0 = 1.22(5)×10−4 s; BRaman = 4.1(2)×10−2 s−1 K−n; n = 5.8(16)
